title: QA Pilot Option B Broker Plan
description: Schema for a QA Pilot broker planning artifact. Defines the Option B Librarian-brokered call path to QA Pilot's MCP surface. This is a planning/design artifact — it does not authorize implementation.

artifact_type.description: Must be 'qa_pilot_broker_plan' to identify this as a broker planning artifact.

planning_mode.description: This sprint is planning-only. planning_only = full planning, read_only_planning = read-only review of an existing plan.

model_type.description: The model type must be Option B (Librarian-brokered).

forward_direction_defined.description: Forward broker direction (Librarian → QA Pilot) must be defined.

reverse_direction_defined.description: Reverse broker direction (QA Pilot → Librarian) is out of scope. Must be false.

librarian_broker_is_optional.description: The Librarian broker layer is optional and future-only.

qa_pilot_surface_remains_qa_pilot_owned.description: QA Pilot's MCP surface remains QA Pilot-owned. The broker does not own handlers.

broker_routes_not_absorbs.description: The broker must route to QA Pilot handlers, not absorb them.

tool_name.description: Planned tool name. Must start with 'planned_librarian_broker_qa_pilot_' to indicate it is a planning artifact, not an implementation.

authority.description: Authority level: R0 = read-only, R1 = advisory mutation.

purpose.description: Brief description of what this planned tool does.

custody_required.description: All broker tools must require custody verification.

planned.description: This is a planned tool, not an implementation. Must be true.

receipt_type.description: Audit receipt type for broker calls.

required_fields.description: Required fields in a broker audit receipt.

storage_location.description: Where broker audit receipts are stored.

retention_policy.description: How long broker audit receipts are retained.

files_to_revert.description: Files that must be reverted on rollback.

audit_cleanup.description: How broker audit records are cleaned up on rollback.

disable_mechanism.description: How the broker can be disabled without deleting code.

project_context_reset.description: How project context is reset after rollback.

post_rollback_validation.description: Validation checks that must pass after rollback.

allowed_files.description: Files a future implementation sprint may touch.

forbidden_files.description: Files a future implementation sprint must not touch.

runtime_mutation_authorized.description: Runtime mutation remains unauthorized by this sprint.

implementation_authorized.description: Implementation is not authorized by this sprint.

option_c_authorized.description: Option C (native MCPController registration) remains not authorized.

reason.description: Why Option C is not authorized.
